A preset that carries the store verbs: Index, search and record claims carries all ten; Full research workflow carries index_corpus and search_corpus.

provenance.hashMethod: SHA-256 measured over the bytes of each file in the payload copy by scripts/build_bundle_catalog.py, then compared byte-for-byte with the staged tree; scripts/verify_vsix.py compares the same digests with the packaged VSIX members.

bundles.purpose: Index user-selected PDF and DOCX files into the corpus and cite them by the page or item of the original document, with coverage, warnings, freshness and the limits of the extraction kept visible. Replaces the 0.3.8 derived-Markdown workaround, which is kept only as an explicit fallback for files the indexer refuses.
bundles.sharedSkillRule: Every skill in `skills` has exactly one owner bundle in `owners`. Only the owner bundle writes that skill's files; another bundle that lists the same skill reports it as shared and writes nothing there. No bundle ever removes a skill, and no bundle removes a skill owned by another bundle.
